Setup.dc.html.title: First run: owner, router, host key

s_overview.text: Overview: router health at a glance. Model, firmware (stock or Merlin, detected), uptime, CPU, memory, temperatures and a live traffic chart. Try: Tweaks > firmware, language, dark, role. Unbuilt in the app yet: live chart data source on a real router.

s_setup.text: First run. Step 1 creates the owner (the first account becomes the owner). Step 2 connects the router with a generated key (default) or the router password, typed only here and stored encrypted. Step 3 shows the router's host key fingerprint to approve once. Try the Next and Back buttons.

s_devices.text: Devices: who is connected, by name, with signal and band. Row actions: rename, reserve address, block internet, wake. Bulk select runs block and reserve on many at once. Viewers see the list without the actions.

s_wifi.text: Wi-Fi: one card per band plus guest networks. Every edit joins the pending bar at the bottom; nothing reaches the router until Preview and Apply. Try flipping a radio or the guest switch and watch the pending count.

s_network.text: Internet (connection type, DNS, dynamic DNS), local network (router address, DHCP range, reservations) and port forwarding rules as a readable table. Changing the router address is a network-affecting change and runs under the connection-loss guard.

s_security.text: Firewall switches, parental controls and the VPN servers (OpenVPN and WireGuard). Models without WireGuard show the control disabled with the reason, never hidden.

s_tools.text: Ping, traceroute and name lookup run on the router itself. The live log has plain search plus the adjacent regex builder. Unbuilt in the app yet: the full regex builder parity set.

s_changes.text: The write path. Preview lists every change in plain words with the old and new value. Network changes arm a guard on the router that puts the old values back after 90 seconds unless the app can still reach it. History keeps every change with Undo. Try the stage buttons: preview, guarded, applied, reverted, failed.

s_advanced.text: Advanced: every remaining router value in a searchable table, catalogue label first and raw key second. Merlin extras (custom scripts, add-ons, Entware) show disabled with the reason on stock firmware: flip Tweaks > firmware.

s_settings.text: App settings: language (English, Cantonese, both), theme, accent, motion, sounds, people and roles. The command palette (Ctrl+Shift+F) reaches every page and action. Unbuilt in the app yet: most of the full feature catalogue; the inventory lists each one.

s_deploy.text: Deploy assistant (desktop companion): one-click Docker hosting here or over SSH, VirtualBox, VMware, USB and Raspberry Pi flashing, plus the instance manager. Design only for now; the companion is not built yet.

s_phone.text: Phone width (390). The rail becomes a bottom bar, cards stack, the pending changes become a bottom sheet. Nothing that is reachable on desktop is removed here.
